resources.string: The encryption key protecting your local data could not be read. This is often temporary — for example right after updating Android. Try again first. If the problem persists, the only way to keep using the app is to erase your data and start fresh.

This permanently deletes your chats, long-term memory, pipelines, presets, workspace files, attachments and scheduled tasks on this device. Your settings and saved keys are kept. This cannot be undone. Type %1$s to confirm.
